input.summary: Prepare Three-Ball Multiball by locking one ball in the Cave and one in the Pit, score at least 70,000 from red targets during multiball to qualify Three-Ball Multi-Mode, then use the two-ball return-lane combo if the Pit shot is uncontrolled.

steps.text: Complete the center five-bank. Shoot the lit Captive Cave to lock the first ball.
modeNotes: Captive Cave: The lower ball-lock saucer. The center five-bank lights it. A shot into the lit Cave locks one ball.
Lock persistence: A locked ball and completed-bank progress stay ready across player balls until the multiball starts.

steps.text: Complete the left five-bank. Shoot through the left spinner into the lit Captive Pit to lock the second ball.
modeNotes: Captive Pit: The upper ball lock behind the left spinner. A Cave lock and a completed left five-bank light it.
Pit lock: The shot locks the second ball. The game serves another ball to the shooter lane.

steps.text: Plunge the third ball. Make the next switch to release both locks and start Three-Ball Multiball.
modeNotes: Three-Ball Multiball: The Cave and Pit locks release after the plunge and next switch. The feature ends when one ball remains.
During three-ball play, each red standup or drop-target hit scores 3,000 and adds 3,000 to Multi-Mode Bonus. The award becomes 2,000 when two balls remain.
Two-Ball Multiball and Three-Ball Multiball are separate starts. They do not stack.

steps.text: During Three-Ball Multiball, hit red standups and drop targets until Multi-Mode Bonus reaches 70,000.
modeNotes: Multi-Mode Bonus: Red targets build this stored score during multiball. Each target adds 1,000 times the number of balls in play.
Three-Ball threshold: Reach 70,000 before normal multiball ends to qualify Three-Ball Multi-Mode.
If the threshold is not reached, the game adds the stored Multi-Mode Bonus once. Bonus X does not multiply it.

steps.text: Keep two or three balls in play while the Multi-Mode Bonus counts down.
modeNotes: Multi-Mode: A timed round after normal multiball. The earned Multi-Mode Bonus becomes the countdown value and is also awarded as it counts down.
The countdown runs more slowly when more balls are in play. The round ends at zero. The playfield then becomes inactive and all remaining balls drain.
The player turn ends after the drain unless an Extra Ball remains.

fallback.title: Two-Ball Multi-Mode
fallback.when: Use this route when the Pit shot rejects or a third ball is not worth the risk.

steps.text: Hit the flashing blue standup on the left. Note which outside return lane lights.
modeNotes: Two-ball lock route: The blue standup lights one outside return lane. A roll through that lane lights the Cave for one immediate shot.
The next switch before the Cave shot removes the light.

steps.text: Roll through the lit return lane. Shoot the Cave before another switch registers.
After the Cave locks the ball, plunge the served ball. Make the next switch to start Two-Ball Multiball.
modeNotes: Two-Ball Multiball: The Cave lock releases after the plunge and next switch. It ends when one ball remains.
During two-ball play, each red standup or drop-target hit scores 2,000 and adds 2,000 to Multi-Mode Bonus.

steps.text: Hit red targets until Multi-Mode Bonus reaches 50,000.
Keep both balls in play during Two-Ball Multi-Mode.
modeNotes: Two-Ball Multi-Mode: It starts after normal multiball when Multi-Mode Bonus reached 50,000. The stored score becomes the countdown.
The feature ends when the countdown reaches zero. The playfield becomes inactive and both balls drain.

alternatives.title: Bonus and lit spinners
alternatives.when: Use this plan when lock shots are not controlled and the top three-bank is safe.

steps.text: Complete the top three-bank and one five-bank for 2x Bonus. Complete both five-banks for 3x Bonus.
modeNotes: Bonus X: The top three-bank plus either five-bank gives 2x. The top bank plus both five-banks gives 3x.
Bonus X multiplies normal end-of-ball bonus. It does not multiply Multi-Mode Bonus.

steps.text: After the top three-bank is complete, roll through a lit inner return lane. Shoot the opposite spinner immediately.
modeNotes: Lit Spinner: The top three-bank lights both inner return lanes. A lit inner lane lights the opposite spinner for one immediate shot.
Another switch removes the spinner light. A lit spinner scores 2,000 and adds normal bonus.

steps.text: Build normal bonus with the upper-right yellow standups and spinners. Protect the 3x collect.

alternatives.title: Ball Save and Extra Ball
alternatives.when: Use this plan only after you confirm the tournament award settings.

steps.text: Complete a drop-target bank to light Ball Save. Use the cabinet button only when the ball enters the left outlane.
modeNotes: Ball Save: A one-use manual left-outlane kicker. A completed target bank lights it. Press the separate left-side cabinet button at the correct time to fire it.
The top red four-target bank can also light it after two completions. The right-bank requirement changes with three-ball or five-ball settings.

steps.text: Complete the right red four-target bank. Shoot the center rollunder if Extra Ball lights.
modeNotes: Extra Ball: The right red bank lights it after one completion in three-ball play or two completions in five-ball play. The center rollunder collects it.
Tournament settings can replace Extra Ball with a repeatable 100,000-point award.

steps.text: Complete the top red four-target sequence twice. Use the right outlane only if the configured Special award is worth the risk.
modeNotes: Special: The top red sequence lights the right outlane after two completions. The operator can set the award to replay, Extra Ball, or points.

steps.text: Lock the first ball in the Cave.
Lock the second ball in the Pit.
Start Three-Ball Multiball and hit red targets for 70,000 Multi-Mode Bonus.
Protect all three balls during the Multi-Mode countdown.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm Gottlieb Devil's Dare, System 80A, from 1982 before using these rules.
Confirm three-ball or five-ball play. The right red bank needs one completion in three-ball play and two in five-ball play for Extra Ball and Ball Save.
Confirm whether Extra Ball becomes a repeatable 100,000-point award and whether Special has tournament value.

techniques.name: One-switch return-lane combo
techniques.instruction: After the lit outside return lane, shoot the Cave before another switch registers. The Cave light lasts for one immediate shot.

techniques.name: Upper-flipper readiness
techniques.instruction: Prepare the upper flipper after a plunge or a Pit eject. The ball can arrive at the upper playfield immediately.

techniques.name: Left-spinner route
techniques.instruction: Shoot the left spinner from the right flipper. If needed, use the left five-bank to redirect the ball toward it.

techniques.name: Manual kickback timing
techniques.instruction: Press the left-side cabinet button only when the ball is in the left outlane kicker. An early or late press wastes the save.

cautions.issue: Center-bank hits can rebound into a slingshot.
cautions.response: Use controlled target hits. Prepare for a fast sideways return.

cautions.issue: Slingshot-top contacts can send the ball toward an outlane.
cautions.response: Nudge before the ball settles on the top edge of a slingshot.

cautions.issue: Upper-playfield exits can return toward the center drain.
cautions.response: Track the exit and prepare both flippers before the ball leaves the upper area.

cautions.issue: The manual Ball Save needs exact button timing.
cautions.response: Wait until the ball reaches the left outlane kicker. Then press the separate cabinet button once.

quickInfo.name: Long goal
quickInfo.summary: Lock the first ball in the Cave.

quickInfo.name: Safer fallback
quickInfo.summary: Two-Ball Multi-Mode: Use this route when the Pit shot rejects or a third ball is not worth the risk.
